name: firebase-ios-sdk
description: Firebase SDK for Apple App Development
one_liner: Google's official toolkit that lets iOS app developers add login, databases, analytics, and push notifications to their apps without building that infrastructure themselves.
buyer: An iOS app developer or small app studio already building on Apple platforms who needs standard backend features fast and cheap.
business_use_cases: An indie iOS developer uses it to add user login and a cloud database to a new app in a day instead of building a custom backend.
A small agency standardizes on it across client apps so every project gets analytics and crash reporting for free.
A startup uses it to ship an MVP fast, then migrates off it once they need custom backend logic at scale.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'Firebase setup and optimization' consulting to app studios that want it integrated correctly and cost-efficiently.
Build and sell boilerplate iOS app templates pre-wired with Firebase for common app categories (fitness, social, marketplace).

steal_this: This weekend, package a ready-to-clone iOS app starter template with Firebase auth, database, and push notifications already wired up, and sell it to indie developers who don't want to set it up themselves.
